description: The most important Romanian news stories right now, ranked like the altziar.ro front page (importance, number of newsrooms, freshness). Optionally filter by category or by local edition (city). Returns title, url, short summary, number of newsrooms and dates for each story. Content is in Romanian.

category.description: Only stories from this category (Romanian names, e.g. "Politică", "Economie", "Sport").

city.description: Only stories from this local edition: cluj, timisoara, brasov or craiova.

limit.description: How many stories to return (1-25, default 10).

name: get_top_stories
title: Top stories in Romania
